pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation via ball-milling and sieving through 20 and 80 mesh screens to obtain particles smaller than 1 mm.
Chemical pretreatment using organosolv solvent concentrations of 50% or 75% vv-1 ethanol solution.
Thermal treatment during the organosolv process at temperatures of 120, 140 and 180 °C for 60 min.
Chemical pretreatment using a catalyst consisting of 1% ww-1 H2SO4 during the organosolv process.

Enzymatic hydrolysis of recovered solids using a mixture of Cellic® CTec2 and Cellic® HTec2 enzymes at a ratio of 1:9 (Htec2 to Ctech2) with an activity of 113.5 FPU mL-1, conducted for 72 h at 45 ± 1 °C and 120 rpm in sodium citrate buffer (50 mM, pH 4.8).
